newsitem.title: USA: Chemi-Trol sees 15 pct decline in 1996 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Chemi-Trol sees 15 pct decline in 1996 EPS.

text.p: Chemi-Trol Chemical Co on Friday said it expected its 1996 earnings to be about 15 percent less than the previous year's profit, largely because of severe weather conditions during the first half.
The company said it expected 1996 revenues to be nearly even with the prior year's result.
In 1995, the company reported net income of $1.48 million, or $0.74 per share, on revenues of $71.05 million.
Chemi-Trol, through four divisions, is involved in the manufacturing and distribution of steel pressure tanks for the storage of liquefied petroleum gas and anhydrous ammonia.
